Name: Jozachar, Son of Shimeath
Summary: Jozachar, son of Shimeath, with Jehozabad, conspired and slew King Joash in the house of Millo.
RelatedPeople: Joash, King of Judah; Shimeath, Mother of Jozachar; Jehozabad, Son of Shomer
LifeLesson: A king who turned from God was slain by the servants he had trusted.
